svg.title: About me: from Counter-Strike 1.6 servers to front-end development. Timeline: first computer at 12, IFG in 2023, capstone featured in 2025, graduated and co-founded RDL Development in 2026.

g.text: I got hooked on code tinkering with Counter-Strike 1.6
servers and never looked back. These days I live on
the front-end: taking an idea, designing the interface
and polishing it until every detail feels right.
Started my degree in Systems Analysis and Development at IFG
My capstone, Mind Health, was featured at IFG's first capstone
Graduated in March and co-founded RDL Development in
